t2.thesis: CMG enters earnings at a 52-week low after a 16% monthly slide with lowered expectations and a roughly 7.5% implied move, which gives a slight edge to a relief bounce, but a fresh downgrade on a slow Q4 start and the salmonella and traffic risks offset that.
reasons: Consumer cluster base rate is 55.5%, and the AMC base rate is 53.8%.
The stock is down 32% over 12 months and 12% over 1 month, at a 52-week low, so expectations are depressed, though the momentum is negative.
The last two prints were strong (+8.9% and +7.0%), but the print before that was -21.8%, which shows large two-way tails.
A bull moved to the sidelines on a slow Q4 start, which is a negative read on the comp trend; RBC sees upside, so analyst views are split.
Large buybacks and 3.4% short interest give modest support, while the jalapeño salmonella issue was not in guidance and adds risk.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 comp sales and transaction trend, plus commentary on Q4 quarter-to-date comps and 2026/2027 guidance.

prior.from: D004 base rates: consumer cluster t0_hit 0.555 (overall 0.54, AMC 0.538)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-10-27, so that earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how Chipotle's (CMG) stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 2.5 points from 0.555 to 0.53 because of the downgrade on a slow Q4 start and negative momentum, partly offset by the depressed setup.

theses.expected: Relief rally on a comp that beats a lowered bar and stable guidance.
theses.mechanism: The stock is at a 52-week low with a low bar, so a modest beat and buyback support can trigger short covering and a rebound.
theses.wrong_if: Comps come in below about 2% or transactions turn negative.

theses.expected: Drop on weak Q4 quarter-to-date commentary and margin pressure.
theses.mechanism: Beef and freight inflation and labor costs compress restaurant margins, and a slow start to Q4 implies a softer 2027.
theses.wrong_if: Management reports Q4 comps accelerating and margins in line or better.

theses.expected: Muted or mixed open-to-open move that depends on guidance.
theses.mechanism: An implied move of about 7.5% already prices in the uncertainty, so the direction depends on whether the guidance tone is unchanged.
theses.wrong_if: Results are clearly well above or well below consensus.

key_observations: Q3 comparable sales and the transaction versus check split
Restaurant-level margin and beef/freight cost outlook
Full-year comp guidance (low single digit) and 2027 unit growth
Salmonella or food safety impact and buyback pace
